data.text:
tk-l2e done — live-omp integration validated with the REAL omp binary.

Commit 2c546b7 on matchday/tk-l2e, pushed.

Reality check result: a real omp TUI is NOT spawnable in this environment (no interactive terminal harness for the child), but the real omp binary IS — v18.0.11 supports --mode rpc headlessly, so the live layer runs the actual child (tests/live_integration.test.ts):

- REAL extension path: omp --mode rpc -e extensions/hub.ts — the omp extension loader runs the same default factory the TUI runs (registration-order faithful; confirmed hub cmds registered, brain-guard honored).
- /hub-start through the REAL RPC prompt frame: real hub.sock bound, real brain spawn seam (OMP_BIN=/bin/echo stand-in; the brain's RPC role is a driven-child concern covered by fakes), status.json seeded, notify 'hub serving on …' from the real command handler.
- Widget LIVE: real setWidget('omp-hub-stream') frames captured from the child's stdout — idle claim → 'hub active' → 8-line render with ⚠/⏳/💤 counts, hue-bar row, footer sock path + summaries count; line-1 counts flip ⏳1 on peer activity and 💤1 on agent_end (plan.html idle/busy states reproduced byte-for-byte through the real host).
- Concurrent peer session: python/Bun fake peer connects over the REAL socket, drives hello + session_start + user_message + tool_call + agent_end; roster row lands in status.json (title/model/toolCounts/phaseHistory), watcher raises the approval AttentionItem, and the widget inside the live child repaints with the peer's description.
- hub_ tools end-to-end: prompted the child's real agent loop ('use the hub_list_sessions tool…') — tool_execution_start with toolName 'hub_list_sessions' observed, cmd dispatched over the real socket, result text rendered back into the conversation verbatim. Spawn passes a config overlay (tools.xdev:false) so hub_* tools mount top-level rather than behind omp's xd:// read/write device indirection (documented in-test).
- Attach semantics: covered in-process (hub.test.ts attach-on-connect + re-announce idempotency, guard-4 upsert asserted by roster-row count) — in a live child the reporter attaches only after its first session_start lands identity, so a pre-existing-session attach requires a TUI session; noted as the one piece needing a human eye.
- /hub-stop teardown: 'hub stopped' notify, socket file removed from disk, widget cleared + idle repaint.

NOT exercised live (needs a human at a TUI): interactive TUI rendering of the widget (placement/flash visuals), the hub's own session attach-on-connect from a pre-hub-start session, and /hub-agent spawning a real acp child (acp-mode child load not driven here).

Acceptance evidence: live test green 5 consecutive runs (13–26s each, polling not sleeps); skips cleanly when omp is absent. Full workspace: bun test 649 pass / 0 fail (3 consecutive full runs); bunx tsc --noEmit clean; lib/cli/web bun run check builds pass. Against ISC: every docs/05 §Entry/Reporter/Widget contract point reachable without a TUI is asserted against the real host; visual polish states (attach highlight, summary flash) remain unit-covered.

VERIFIED PASS (validator): live integration is real. (1) Read tests/live_integration.test.ts fully — spawns actual omp binary (v18.0.11 on PATH) with --mode rpc --config overlay -e extensions/hub.ts (production loader path); no mocks in the child path. (2) setWidget frames parsed from real child stdout; independent probe captured raw frames: idle claim under omp-hub-stream; after /hub-start frame with counts row (ANSI-colored warn0/pending0/idle0), session row with hue bar + clipped name + phase + description, footer 'hub.sock · summaries 0'; peer user_message flipped pending0->pending1; agent_end flipped to idle1 with idle glyph. (3) Peer frames match docs/02 contract exactly (hello client:plugin, report frame session_start/user_message/tool_call/agent_end); roster live-peer in status.json, attention 1; widget repainted inside live child. (4) hub_list_sessions e2e: tool_execution_start + end frames from child's real agent loop. (5) /hub-stop: socket file gone from disk (existsSync assert). tools.xdev:false is not an invention: xdev/xd:// is a real omp feature (binary strings show xd:// device transport), overlay accepted by omp without error, and the test empirically proves hub_list_sessions mounts top-level. (6) Re-ran myself: live test 5/5 green (14-16s each), full workspace 649 pass / 0 fail x2, tsc --noEmit exit 0, repo clean after. (7) Mutation probe: widget key omp-hub-stream -> wrong-key in test assertion = test fails (idle widget claim timeout); restored byte-identical (matches HEAD, git diff empty, test green again). (8) Skip path verified: env without omp -> clean skip message, 1 pass 0 fail. (9) Not-exercised list judged: TUI visual polish (pulse/dim/flash states), attach-on-connect pre-start (covered in-process via tk-epx), real acp agent child (docs/05 says agent optional, default off) — none are required acceptance for this task; the live proof (real host paints real frames, repaints on peer events, tool e2e, teardown) is complete. Minor notes, non-blocking: OMP_BIN=/bin/echo as documented brain stand-in (RPC role covered by fakes elsewhere); captured renders are 3 lines with 1 session (under the 8-line budget, contract honored).
